item.title: NYC reverses Upper West Side middle school closure after mom’s viral racist remark sparks outcry
item.description: Chancellor Kamar Samuels reversed plans to phase out the Community Action School after an Upper West Side mom’s racist comments sparked outrage.

item.title: Supreme Court finds parents have a right to know about gender transitions at school
item.description: Protesters supporting transgender athletes competing in women's sports wave a transgender pride flag outside the Supreme Court on Jan. 13, 2026 in Washington, D.C. In a 6-3 ruling Monday in a separate case, the court found parents have a right to know about their child's gender identity at school.

item.title: NYC to launch ‘2-K’: Here are the neighborhoods getting free child care for 2-year-olds this fall
item.description: Gov. Kathy Hochul with Mayor Zohran Mamdani at a Brooklyn child care center on Jan. 8. The governor and mayor on Tuesday unveiled the first NYC neighborhoods getting free child care seats for 2-year-olds.

item.title: Red states are taking control of school districts as Republicans decry poor test scores, student protests
item.description: In October 2025, Texas announced it would take over Fort Worth's school district and replace its school board. (Chris Torres/Fort Worth Star-Telegram/Tribune News Service via Getty Images)

item.title: Future of IPS hinges on possible tax increase proposed by a new corporation, not the school board
item.description: The newly created Indianapolis Public Education Corporation will have the power to ask voters for more funding for schools like George Julian School 57 in Irvington.

item.title: ‘It should raise eyebrows’: Former Chancellor Aviles-Ramos takes job at firm with ties to NYC schools
item.description: Former NYC Chancellor Melissa Aviles-Ramos took a job at HMH, a curriculum company at the center of former Mayor Eric Adams’ signature literacy overhaul.

item.title: After possible building sale, Chicago Public Schools agrees to lease space for Acero Santiago
item.description: Acero Santiago, a charter school, reopens for the first day of school on Thurs., Aug. 14, 2025. After a possible of the school building, CPS has agreed to rent the school site for the next 10 years.

item.title: Trump aims to shrink the Education Department — while Washington tightens its grip on schools
item.description: Secretary of Education Linda McMahon speaks outside the U.S. Supreme Court as justices hear arguments in challenges to state bans on transgender athletes in women's sports on January 13, 2026, in Washington, D.C.

item.title: The Detroit school district considers a charter application with a cap on enrolling its own students
item.description: Detroit Public Schools Community District is considering authorizing a new charter school focused on developing young athletes. The proposed contract would allow DPSCD high schools to recruit students from the charter.

item.title: Tennessee teachers face new licensure test requirement under proposed bill
item.description: Tennessee lawmakers are considering a new bill that could require some Tennessee teachers pass a civics test before getting a state teaching license.
